name: Avatar
summary: Represent a person or entity with a photo or their initials.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-avatar> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; shows the image from `src`, or the initials of `name` on a tinted ground. A purely static display marker, so it declares no motion. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: name
props.desc: Full name; initials are derived when no src

whenToUse.when: identifying a person or entity — a presenter, a participant, an author
a generic symbol, not a specific identity
labelling with a category rather than an identity

opinion.note: Always provide `name` even when `src` is set — it becomes the alt text and the initials fallback if the image fails.
opinion.dsv3: Initials ground uses bg-accent (#F9F5FF) with purple-60 (#6A1EBB) text — the brand-tint pairing already used across the system. Circle is the pill radius; square is the default 8 radius.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is the default 40px initials avatar.
